title: The company
para1: Bigframe Technology Co., Ltd. designs and manufactures structured-light 3D cameras and the TridiVision software that runs them. Founded in 2021 and based in Kunshan, Suzhou, the company continues the 3D vision work begun in 2015 by Imalligent Technology (Shanghai), now its wholly owned subsidiary. Its eighteen camera models in five series measure, inspect and guide on production lines in consumer electronics, semiconductor packaging, batteries, automotive and logistics.
para2: Every camera except the preliminary PRS is characterized by the same published method — regional Z repeatability, 2σ, on a ceramic reference plate at three working distances.
